newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Koa Denko suspended to answer query-KLSE.
newsitem.headline: Koa Denko suspended to answer query-KLSE.

text.p: Shares of electrical products maker Koa Denko (Malaysia) Bhd have been suspended to answer a query about unusual market activity in its stock, a Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) official said on Thursday.
"They have to reply on unusual market action," the official said.
The stock was suspended at around 0150 GMT. It was last traded at 11.50 ringgit, down 30 cents.
At 11.50, the shares had jumped 42.8 percent from 8.05 ringgit on January 2.
Company officials could not be immediately reached for comment.
